    Configured bot definitions currently loaded.

    Instances actively processing bars.

    Loaded but intentionally halted from trading.

    Reconciling-

    Instances inside reconciliation workflows.

    Stopped-

    Definitions not currently supervised.

    Recon Blocked-

    Instances prevented from new trading until resolved.

    Warmup Ready-

    Instances with confirmed-history warmup complete.

    Warmup Pending-

    Instances still ingesting confirmed history before they can trade.

    Warmup Failed-

    Instances waiting on backfill recovery or live confirmed catch-up.

    Kill Switch-

    Emergency stop state for new intents.

    Service Ready-

    Readiness based on runtime initialization.

    Connectors Up-

    Connected adapters versus total visible adapters.
